title: Does the Observed Cost Unit Preserve US30 Endpoint Spread Shape?

research_height.transfer_path: Entry/exit-time quoted spread can determine whether the lifecycle cost unit used by the 2x/3x/4x portfolio envelope preserves component-specific microstructure burden or hides it behind a scalar stress.

central_question: Within the complete 2026 US30 lifecycle population covered by the immutable M30 export, does Unit 039's per-lifecycle observed cost unit track the entry-plus-exit quoted-spread shape strongly and consistently enough to preserve its US30 cost-resilience interpretation?

research_bundle.name: pooled_rank_association_two_segment_repetition_and_component_ratio_alignment
lenses: microstructure mechanism: lifecycle observed cost unit versus M30 entry-plus-exit quoted-spread proxy
temporal falsification: the same Spearman association in fixed January-March and April-July segments
portfolio evidence transfer: four US30 component mean cost ratios versus mean spread-proxy ratios

idea_provenance.authority_note: The memo's claim of a flat cost amount is corrected before outcomes: Unit 039 uses a lifecycle-specific observed cost unit and applies flat scalar multipliers to that unit. This unit tests whether the base unit already carries endpoint spread shape.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 039's arithmetic envelope is authoritative but explicitly does not prove that spread, commission, swap and slippage scale identically. Unit 073's current-spec direct entry-cost recorder was identically zero, leaving the existing CP2 cost unit's market-shape responsiveness unresolved.
why_now.connection_bridge: Unit 063 produced a hash-pinned 19,604-row US30 M30 spread path with exact candidate-bar parity. The P4 CP2 events preserve all four US30 lifecycle endpoints and Unit 039's exact observed cost-unit formula.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 078 was Program 4 lifecycle-extrema coordinate integrity. Unit 079 moves to Program 7 evidence-model diagnosis, joins independent bar microstructure to CP2 cost accounting, and transfers only to Program 5 evidence authority.
why_now.decision_if_true: Preserve Unit 039's US30 cost-envelope interpretation as time-shape responsive, while keeping its explicit limit that scalar stress is not future broker proof.
why_now.decision_if_false: Downgrade Unit 039's US30 component cost-resilience ranking as spread-shape-blind. Do not recalculate, remove, reprioritize or resize any component in this unit.
why_now.decision_if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Leave Unit 039 unchanged at its prior bounded authority, record the diagnostic limitation and rotate away.

frozen_lifecycle_and_join_semantics.ordering: Sort mapped OPEN, CLOSE and EXTERNAL_CLOSE events by parsed server_time and numeric state_sequence. Each component must strictly alternate one OPEN then one final event.
frozen_lifecycle_and_join_semantics.population_boundary: Keep only lifecycle pairs whose OPEN and final server_time are both earlier than 2026-08-01 00:00:00. The export boundary is data availability fixed independently of lifecycle outcomes.
frozen_lifecycle_and_join_semantics.observed_cost_unit: final value_a minus final value_b in USD; require finite and nonnegative. This is exactly Unit 039's base unit.
frozen_lifecycle_and_join_semantics.bar_key: Floor each birth and final event server time to the containing physical 30-minute boundary, format as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, and exact-match US30_M30_BARS.time_utc.
frozen_lifecycle_and_join_semantics.endpoint_spread_proxy: entry-bar spread plus final-bar spread in raw quoted points; require both finite and strictly positive.
frozen_lifecycle_and_join_semantics.calendar_segments: SEGMENT_A is birth time before 2026-04-01 00:00:00; SEGMENT_B is birth time on or after that boundary through July.

frozen_metrics.rank_method: Spearman correlation using ascending average ranks for ties, calculated only when both vectors have positive rank variance.
frozen_metrics.pooled_association: Spearman between observed_cost_unit_usd and endpoint_spread_proxy across all 122 lifecycles.
frozen_metrics.segment_association: The same Spearman separately in SEGMENT_A and SEGMENT_B without component weighting or pooling of coefficients.
frozen_metrics.component_ratios: For each component, its mean cost unit divided by pooled mean cost unit and its mean endpoint spread divided by pooled mean endpoint spread.
frozen_metrics.ratio_mismatch: For each component, max(cost_ratio/spread_ratio, spread_ratio/cost_ratio); report the maximum across four components. All denominators must be strictly positive.

requirements: All seven byte/hash pins and prior schema/verdict/formula anchors pass.
The bar export has exactly 19,604 unique strictly increasing rows with finite nonnegative spread.
Reconstruction yields exactly 122 complete through-July lifecycles with component counts 39, 29, 25 and 29 and no overlap/orphan.
Every lifecycle maps both endpoints to exactly one bar with strictly positive spread and has finite nonnegative cost unit; at least 90% of cost units are strictly positive.
Each component has at least 10 lifecycles in each fixed calendar segment, and pooled/segment cost and spread ranks all have positive variance.
SEGMENT_A and SEGMENT_B Spearman are each at least +0.25.
Maximum four-component mean ratio mismatch is at most 1.25x.
Absolute pooled Spearman is at most 0.10.
Absolute SEGMENT_A and SEGMENT_B Spearman are each at most 0.10.
Maximum component mean ratio mismatch is at least 1.50x.

fixed_verdict_rules.falsified: US30_COST_UNIT_SPREAD_SHAPE_BLIND_DOWNGRADE_UNIT_039_RANK_AUTHORITY when integrity passes and every shape-blind requirement passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_US30_COST_UNIT_SPREAD_SHAPE_NO_POLICY_CHANGE when integrity passes and neither preceding rule applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_US30_COST_UNIT_SPREAD_SHAPE_NO_VERDICT when any immutable, lifecycle, join, positivity, density or rank-variance condition fails.

decision_translation.complete: Preserve Unit 039's US30 cost-resilience interpretation while retaining its existing non-broker-proof limit; make no component or cost-policy change.
decision_translation.falsified: Downgrade Unit 039's relative US30 component cost-rank authority, but preserve all components and behavior and open no replacement model automatically.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Leave Unit 039 unchanged at prior bounded authority and rotate away.
